outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the closed drawer in frames 0–70 and closes its gripper around the handle in frames 71–79 (wrist_image). It pulls the drawer outward in frames 88–106, exposing the interior and utensils (image and left_ego_image). After releasing the handle and withdrawing in frames 110–161, the drawer remains visibly open (image). No failed attempts or unintended side effects are visible.
